programs.Blurb 1: The benefits of chess are myriad. For novices learning the basics to experts practicing for chess competition, our program improves problem-solving, pattern recognition, and strategic thinking.
programs.Blurb 2: Chess study has many merits away from the board. Our students exercise the cognitive skills of focus, patience, and decision-making, as well as the interpersonal skills of respect and sportsmanship.
programs.Blurb 3: Our students build their skillsets from term to term. As such, we do not repeat specific lessons within a school year. Instead, we find fresh and exciting methods to explore the main themes of the game.
programs.Key info - body: We encourage participants from all experience levels. Our chess courses are grouped by like-skilled players so that instructors can deliver lessons and individual feedback appropriate to each and every player—from the newbie to the experienced competitor.
programs.Key info 2- body: Based on skill and experience we designate each of our students an Extra Ed chess level: Pawn, Knight, Rook, Bishop, Queen or King. We use these levels to group students for instruction, track their progress, and pair them in chess tournaments.
programs.Key info 3 - title: Available as a TDSB Partnership Program.
programs.Key info 3- body: To learn about our chess program that is delivered under the TDSB Partnership Program, please visit our Chess for STEM and SEL/Échecs pour STIM et AS page.
programs.Curriculum intro: Dependent on chess level and experience students may be instructed in:
programs.Curriculum body: Level 1, Pawn: Introduction to the game; piece-movement; and capture.

programs.Club title: Chess for STEM and SEL/Échecs pour STIM et AS
programs.Blurb 1: This program approaches crucial mathematical, scientific, and social emotional learning concepts through the game of chess. We use demonstration, storytelling, and a variety of original educational materials that ensure accessibility for each student.
programs.Blurb 2: Illustrating curriculum concepts, such as pattern recognition or spacial reasoning, from a chess-based perspective gives students unique and memorable way to grasp these concepts. This novel approach brings ideas to light in ways that may better suit a broader range of leaning styles.
programs.Blurb 3: Science and chess share in common the need for problem solving and probabilistic thinking. As students engage in individual challenges, small group work, and student-to-student games, they are able to apply these concepts they are learning directly to the practicalities of the game at hand.
programs.Key info - body: Our chess course has been designed and approved to be delivered in-class, during instructional time. As a TDSB Partnership program, it supplements and supports specific outcomes from the Ontario Mathematics and Science & Technology Curricula. It is delivered at multiple grade levels. Learn more>
programs.Curriculum intro: Appropriate to their grade level and working to specific outcomes defined by school curriculum, students may be instructed in:
programs.Curriculum body: Practicing positive motivation and perseverance in facing challenges on the chessboard.

programs.Blurb 1: Students are introduced to the basic logic and principles of programming. They build familiarity with these concepts through fun and simple exercises following ordered sets of commands
programs.Blurb 2: Next, we dig deeper as students add some personal flair by editing their code. With some trial-and-error along the way, they customize sprites, alter images, and add their own stories as text.
programs.Blurb 3: Adding the power of loops, conditions, and other programming tools students complete their own simple games and fun exercises.
programs.Key info - body: Dependent on level, our students either use block coding programs, such as Scratch or a standard programming language such as Python.
programs.Key info 2- body: Lessons and exercises are built to introduce and practice the following concepts:
programs.Curriculum intro: Logical sequence
programs.Curriculum body: Reading and changing numbers on the code

programs.Blurb 1: Group builds are more fun. Our LEGO program fosters a cooperative building environment where children learn to communicate effectively, share ideas, and work together towards a common goal.
programs.Blurb 2: By manipulating Lego bricks, kids enhance their fine motor skills, spatial awareness, and hand-eye coordination. They learn through trial and error, developing patience and persistence along the way.
programs.Blurb 3: Building with LEGO bricks encourages children to think critically, problem-solve, and express unique ideas. We aim to foster a sense of imagination and empower children to bring their visions to life.
programs.Key info - body: Our LEGO student program does not build from kits. We focus on open-ended-play, where inventiveness and imagination stem from students building without constraints. When every build is original, every build is more fun.
programs.Key info 2- body: Each week students are tasked with a new challenge or project, for instance:
programs.Curriculum intro: Collaborative team builds
programs.Curriculum body: Theme-based builds such as zoos, cities, parks, or dream homes

programs.Blurb 1: Working in groups, students tackle each LEGO robotics build together. They make a plan, assign roles among their team, and follow step-by-step instructions to completion.
programs.Blurb 2: Students are challenged with programming various motors to operate their robots. Problem-solving skills are put to test as students troubleshoot the task of springing their creations into action.
programs.Blurb 3: Building from the instructions is only half the fun. Once familiar with the functions and logic of their LEGO kits, students engage their creative minds as they invent original creations.
programs.Key info - body: Dependent on student age, our program provides either LEGO Spike Essentials or LEGO Spike Prime robotics kits.

programs.Curriculum intro: The basic logic of programming

programs.Blurb 1: Experience learning like never before with Minecraft: Education Edition. From building structures to exploring ecosystems, this program draws on hundreds of lessons created by educators around the world.
programs.Blurb 2: Minecraft provides an expansive digital hub in which participants build, explore, and learn in an immersive, pixelated world. Our program fosters creativity, critical thinking, and a love for knowledge.
programs.Blurb 3: Participants hone their 21st century skills as they merge gaming excitement with educational exploration. In this dynamic environment they delve into subjects as diverse as STEM, history, coding, and language arts.
programs.Key info - body: Participants explore in safe and secure environments, all generated within Minecraft: Education Edition. Personalized experiences and accessibility features ensure a positive and inclusive learning atmosphere for all.

programs.Curriculum intro: Building a simple house in Minecraft.

programs.Blurb 1: Whether observing bubbles to understand surface tension, or visualizing how sound waves reverberate using lengths of string, we unravel complex concepts with fun and illustrative weekly experiments.
programs.Blurb 2: What shapes make strong structures? What happens when we mix these? What grows in a terrarium? To answer these questions (and more) these students learn to employ hypothesis, observation and analysis.
programs.Blurb 3: From many different branches of science—the physics of flight, the chemistry of photosynthesis, the biology of terrarium life—we connect students with the scientific workings of the world around them.
programs.Key info - body: Our course is designed to accommodate a wide range of students. Its experiments are clear, engaging and easy to follow for scientists of any age. More experienced groups analyze their findings in greater depth and discuss real life application of the scientific principles involved.
programs.Key info 2- body: Appropriate to their age and capabilities we do weekly experiments in biology, physics, chemistry, and astronomy. Lessons may include:
programs.Curriculum title: Building scale models of the solar system
programs.Curriculum intro: Observing photosynthetic reactions in plant leaves
programs.Curriculum body: Creating an eruption using simple substances

programs.Blurb 1: From basics like spending and savings, to advanced concepts like investment vehicles and compound interest, we give students the foundational financial principles they need to plan for their futures.
programs.Blurb 2: Financial decisions can be daunting. Our lessons and activities are designed to show the long-term cost/benefit of these choices, helping students take control as they reach for their financial goals.
programs.Blurb 3: With engaging, easy-to-understand visual presentations, and activities with personal stakes, such as our “Net Worth Tournament,” we turn a subject that might otherwise be dull into one that is memorable and inspiring.
programs.Key info - body: This program has been designed and approved to be delivered in-class, during instructional time. As a TDSB Partnership program, it supplements and supports specific outcomes from the Ontario Mathematics Curriculum. It is delivered to grades 4 through 6. Learn more>

programs.Curriculum body: An introduction to currency, savings, banks, and borrowing money

programs.Tagline: It's never too early to start your start up.
programs.Blurb 1: We introduce fundamental concepts in financial literacy, business structure, and funding models, giving students a solid base of basic business knowledge and terminology to work from.
programs.Blurb 2: Through exciting activities and engaging exercises our instructors foster an entrepreneurial spirit. They encourage students to think creatively, generate innovative ideas, and to take risks.
programs.Blurb 3: Pitches and presentations are integral to our program. Students will put their communication and leadership skills to the test in a constructive and positive environment.
programs.Key info - body: Our program asks students to consider ethical and responsible entrepreneurship. We emphasize the importance of social responsibility, sustainability, and community-enhancing business practices.

programs.Curriculum body: Financial literacy and business fundamentals

programs.Club title: Safe and Sound On Your Own
programs.Blurb 1: Being independent requires responsibility and critical thinking. Through games and roleplay activities, our participants will learn to anticipate, react to, or rectify common home-alone challenges.
programs.Blurb 2: Our program teaches practical lessons in situational awareness, street and bike safety, and confident self-expression to help young pedestrians learn to navigate their surroundings independently.
programs.Blurb 3: Through a series of engaging, game-based activities, we teach kids how to engage with online games, shops, and chats safely—building awareness of phishing, cyberbullying, and other online risks.
programs.Key info - body: In a fun and supportive setting, we cover safety topics applicable to a wide range of ages. Our activities are always scaled to suit the appropriate level of the students.
programs.Curriculum intro: Appropriate to their age and abilities, students may be instructed in:
programs.Curriculum body: How to pack and store an emgerency kit.

programs.Blurb 1: From knot-tying to shelter-building, kids develop essential survival techniques that spark independence, encourage resilience, and build confidence through creative, hands-on challenges.
programs.Blurb 2: Explorers learn to recognize bird calls, find and follow tracks, and read the clouds to predict weather patterns—developing curiosity, attentiveness, and a stronger connection to the natural world around them.
programs.Blurb 3: With maps, compasses, and even homemade sundials, students build navigation skills while learning how to prepare and adapt—tools that foster self-reliance, empowerment and critical thinking.
programs.Key info - body: Either within a classroom setting or, weather permitting, out-and-about in the schoolyard and play-spaces, we tailor our scouting lessons to the particular age levels of our intrepid explorers.

programs.Curriculum body: How to tie knots.

programs.Blurb 3: We always have ample paper on hand because our students draw non-stop. By program’s end they will each have a folder of their work, brimming with art to feel proud of.

programs.Blurb 2: Through pictures and words our students' characters come alive in their own worlds. We explore storytelling using humour, action, mystery and drama as each student tells a tale as unique as they are.
programs.Blurb 3: With an eye to creating expressive dialogue and descriptive visuals, we aim for each student to complete their own original comic book—so clear some space on your bookshelves!

programs.Blurb 3: Our students see their projects through to completion. Tying-off the final knot of an intricate bracelet or unfolding a delicate origami crane always brings satisfaction and a sense of accomplishment.

programs.Blurb 2: Choosing a project from design patterns of shirts, skirts, stuffed animals and more, students learn the basics of working with patterns, understanding their notation, and applying order of operations.
programs.Blurb 3: Our instructors demonstrate embroidery, creative fabric uses, and pattern modification all as ways for students to customize their projects and give them a personal touch.
programs.Key info - body: We tailor student projects to an appropriately complex pattern selection. There's room for everyone in this program, from complete newbies to seasoned stitchers.

programs.Blurb 1: With a little patience and perseverance our students quickly begin to surprise themselves.  Tricks once thought difficult and mysterious become achievable and fun. Confidence appears out of nowhere.
programs.Blurb 2: Magic tricks employ misdirection, deception, and sleight-of-hand. Analyzing a trick and learning how to perform it exercises critical thinking and problem solving—both vital to the study of magic.
programs.Blurb 3: We provide a variety of opportunities for students to perform their magic. As the develop unique routines they learn to present themselves effectively, communicate clearly, and engage with others.
programs.Key info - body: The tricks our magicians teach require no special equipment. They are easily performed with everyday household items so that participants can recreate their burgeoning magic acts to dazzle friends and family.

programs.Blurb 1: Our program builds the skills necessary to connect music with story. Pitch, tone and breathing fundamentals are complemented by lessons in interpreting lyrics and conveying the meaning of a song.
programs.Blurb 2: Our instructors use scene work and rehearsals to guide students through techniques for conveying the dramatic intent of a scene, such as expression, gestures, blocking, and vocal inflection.
programs.Blurb 3: As they work towards their ensemble piece, students introduce movement and dance to their performance. They work both from their own improvised movements and from group choreography.
programs.Key info - body: Our program culminates in a final showcase from our student ensemble. Chosen by the students from a selection of popular musicals, the performance is recorded for posterity and the video shared with participating families so they can partake in the fun.

programs.Blurb 1: Using pen, paper, camera and clay, participants learn the basics of stop motion. They delight in seeing their own animations spring to life as they test their patience, planning and creativity.
programs.Blurb 2: Modelling clay is an ideal material for beginners and experts alike. Our program teaches how to craft clay characters for animation and how to manipulate them shot-by-shot as we create movie magic.
programs.Blurb 3: Animation takes a lot of teamwork. While collaborating on more complex projects participants learn to animate their characters, props and scenes as a group—creating more complex and rewarding work.
programs.Key info - body: We use a free, cloud-based animation platform. This intuitive program allows users of all ages to get started quickly and easily. Running directly in a web browser, it can be accessed anywhere allowing participants to continue to create at home.

programs.Blurb 1: Making a great video takes more than just hitting record. We start our program by introducing students to the power of scripting, directing, and editing to make content that stands above the rest.
programs.Blurb 2: Teamwork is vital to our program. Whether they are acting, shooting, making props, or assisting each other, every student learns to work on a crew in order to bring each of their projects to life.
programs.Blurb 3: Telling stories in a time-based medium is not as easy as it looks. Students will put their communication skills to they test as they bring their footage together into artfully-crafted final projects.
programs.Themes body: Our program uses Clip Champ, a free, online video-editing software that is intuitive and easy to learn. Student work is stored on the cloud to allow for access outside of class.
programs.Curriculum intro: Our lessons cover video-creation from concept to completion. They include:
programs.Curriculum body: Saving, importing, exporting footage with Google Drive

programs.Blurb 1: Starting with basic tools, students are introduced to digital painting software where they experiment with art techniques already familiar to them in analog mediums.
programs.Blurb 2: Once comfortable with digital painting basics, students are taught a pixel-art program where they use paint tools and layers to make their own custom emojis, icons and characters.
programs.Blurb 3: Students integrate digital drawings, pixel-art, and photographs together using image-editing software. This fun, experimental experience lets them explore the possibilities of digital art.
programs.Themes body: Our program uses three, easy-to-learn, online software platforms: Procreate for digital painting, Pixil, a "pixel-art" maker, and Photopea, a photo-editing program.
programs.Curriculum intro: Lessons and exercises are built to introduce and practice the following concepts:
programs.Curriculum body: Art fundamentals - line, shape, colour, form

programs.Blurb 1: Students will turn creative ideas into playable video games using the Scratch platform. They’ll design characters, code simple game mechanics, and be introduced to the exciting world of game development.
programs.Blurb 2: Through hands-on activities, students will explore essential coding concepts like motion, events, loops, and variables. Each week, they’ll build new skills and apply them to their own game projects.
programs.Blurb 3: By the end of the program, students will have created their very own video games. They’ll share their creations with classmates and can continue to access their games in their Scratch accounts from home.
programs.Themes body: This program is designed for beginners. All students need is an email address to save their Scratch projects. Instructors will guide them step-by-step.
programs.Curriculum intro: Appropriate to their age and abilities, students may be instructed in:
programs.Curriculum body: Designing customized sprites.
programs.Equipment title: Students need an email address if they wish to save their Scratch projects.
programs.Equipment body: No spercial software is required to access Scratch projects at home.

programs.Tagline: Drop that screen and break a sweat.
programs.Blurb 1: Physical activity is the name of the game. Each class we follow a routine of warm ups, stretching, drills, and a friendly match in that day’s featured sport.
programs.Blurb 2: Build concentration and coordination with sport-specific skill exercises such as passing drills for soccer or basketball dribbling challenges, each particular to that day’s sport.
programs.Blurb 3: During games, our encouraging instructors place emphasis on participation and sportsmanship. We play hard, but winning and losing take a backseat to fair play and teamwork.
programs.Themes body: Our instructors are mindful to divide class games into like-aged or like-experienced groups so that everyone feels included in the fun, regardless of skill level.
programs.Curriculum intro: Dependent on weather and school facilities, the following sports MAY be featured:
programs.Curriculum body: Basketball

programs.Tagline: It’s never too early for sun salutations.
programs.Blurb 1: Physical activity is essential to a healthy lifestyle. Our instructors guide students through series of yoga poses that build strength, develop flexibility and improve posture.
programs.Blurb 2: Whether expressing playful themes, inventing student-led yoga games, or participating in cross-curriculum activities such as art or storytelling, we always incorporate creativity and fun to our practice.
programs.Blurb 3: Our program offers a peaceful respite from the hectic day. By connecting with their breath, students improve their focus and hone their concentration skills—benefits that carry beyond the mat.
programs.Themes body: No matter your experience level, there’s room for everyone in our yoga program. From absolute beginners to experienced practitioners, we ensure students can work at their own pace in a supportive and welcoming environment.

programs.Tagline: Are you ready to rock?!! (on acoustic guitar)
programs.Blurb 1: Between warm up exercises, strumming and picking techniques, and simple chord formation students jump right into the fun of making music from their very first lesson.
programs.Blurb 2: Since we have students with a range of playing skills our instructors have them work in parallel, with each student practicing songs and exercises appropriate to their abilities.
programs.Blurb 3: Our instructors are mindful to take time with each student to assess their skill level, instil correct technical habits, and find just the right songs to engage their musical tastes.

programs.Themes body: Extra Ed provides student-sized acoustic guitars with nylon strings to each participant. Between classes students take their instruments home to practice and serenade their families (serenade optional).

programs.Blurb 1: In an encouraging environment that stresses fun and play, this program introduces students to the fundamentals of music-making and song using their voices, hands, and percussive instruments.
programs.Blurb 2: With triangles, maracas, and castanets in hand, students are taught to find the rhythm of a song and play along. They hone their listening and focus skills as they keep in time and play as a group.
programs.Blurb 3: Using a leader-and-callback stye instructors and students practice connecting words and songs. Students gain confidence as they explore melody, learn to sing in unison and perform with joy.
programs.Themes body: All our kindergarten programs are designed with age-appropriate curriculums that focuses on activity, play and exploration. Our kindergarten instructors in this program are experienced, patient and engaging for younger groups.

programs.Blurb 3: Lasting connections are forged through the shared language of music. As young talents collaborate in a supportive group setting they foster camaraderie and a shared love of musical expression.

programs.Blurb 1: Whether observing bubbles to understand surface tension or visualizing how sound waves reverberate using lengths of string, we unravel complex concepts with fun and illustrative weekly experiments.
programs.Blurb 2: What shapes make strong structures? What happens when we mix these? What grows in a terrarium? To answer these questions (and more) these students learn to employ hypothesis, observation and analysis.
programs.Blurb 3: From many different branches of science—the physics of flight, the chemistry of photosynthesis, the biology of terrarium life—we connect students with the scientific workings of the world around them.
programs.Key info - body: Our course is designed to accommodate a wide range of students. Its experiments are clear, engaging and easy to follow for scientists of any age. More experienced groups analyze their findings in greater depth and discuss real life application of the scientific principles involved.
programs.Curriculum intro: Appropriate to their age and capabilities we do facinating and fun weekly experiments. Lessons may include:
programs.Curriculum body: Using ballons to make rockets

programs.Blurb 1: With the aim of blending fun, education, and character development, our program introduces young players to the key foundational aspects of the game—starting with taking turns!
programs.Blurb 2: We teach the roles of each chess piece in an inventive, kindergarten-relatable fashion. Through a combination of imaginative stories, dramatic play, and hands-on practice students will learn movement, positioning and strengths.
programs.Blurb 3: Breaking down the game into smaller, more digestible activities, we use exercises and puzzles to teach concepts such as attacking with diagonal movements or how to position multiple pieces in concert with each other.
programs.Key info - body: Chess isn't just a game, it's a lesson in sportsmanship and resilience. Our kindergarten course introduces young players to chess with an emphasis on respect, fair play, and graceful behaviour—both on and off the board.

programs.Clubs - body: Our Clubs are run as extracurricular programming in schools across the Greater Toronto Area. With exciting subjects, engaging instructors, and hands-on activities, this program offers educational experiences beyond the school curriculum. Learn more>
programs.In-school - body: This program (delivered in-school, during class time) has been designed to supplement and extend Ontario school curriculum. Our experiential mode of instruction brings unique activities into any classroom, resulting in meaningful and memorable learning outcomes. Learn more> [link to In-Class Enrichment page]
